scripts.dev: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts npm run dev:configured
scripts.db:lint: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/supabase/dist/supabase.js db lint --local --schema public,private --fail-on warning
scripts.db:types: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/supabase/dist/supabase.js gen types typescript --local > packages/network-protocol/src/database.types.ts && prettier --write packages/network-protocol/src/database.types.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: tsc -b packages/game-core packages/network-protocol apps/client && vite build --config apps/client/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.test:multiplayer: vitest run packages/network-protocol apps/game-server apps/client/tests/prediction.test.ts apps/client/tests/interpolation.test.ts apps/client/tests/MultiplayerBridge.test.ts apps/client/tests/MultiplayerClient.test.ts apps/client/tests/OnlineUi.test.tsx && playwright test tests/e2e/multiplayer.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:combat: vitest run packages/game-core/tests/combat-phase3.test.ts packages/network-protocol apps/game-server/tests/combatSimulation.test.ts apps/game-server/tests/combatRoom.test.ts apps/client/tests/combatEvents.test.ts apps/client/tests/MultiplayerBridge.test.ts apps/client/tests/OnlineUi.test.tsx && playwright test tests/e2e/combat.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:hardening: vitest run apps/game-server/tests/fixedStepScheduler.test.ts apps/game-server/tests/spatialGrid.test.ts apps/game-server/tests/monsterNavigator.test.ts apps/game-server/tests/schemaProjection.test.ts apps/game-server/tests/combatSimulation.test.ts apps/client/tests/MultiplayerBridge.test.ts apps/client/tests/OnlineUi.test.tsx && playwright test tests/e2e/hardening.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:database: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run apps/game-server/tests/databaseIntegration.test.ts
scripts.test:security: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run apps/game-server/tests/authVerifier.test.ts apps/game-server/tests/databaseIntegration.test.ts
scripts.test:restart: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run apps/game-server/tests/databaseIntegration.test.ts
scripts.assets:screenshots: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/e2e/persistence.spec.ts
scripts.secrets:scan: node --env-file=.env --env-file-if-exists=.env.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/local-supabase-runtime.ts node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs tools/scan-client-secrets.ts
